question: The Golden Temple, which is situated in Amritsar, Punjab, is alternatively known as _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Harmandir Sahib**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Golden Temple**, located in **Amritsar, Punjab**, is a renowned religious site for followers of **Sikhism**. It is also referred to as **Sri Harmandir Sahib**, which means "The Abode of God."
 
• The temple is known for its architectural beauty, spiritual significance, and its role as the most sacred place in Sikhism.
 
• The Golden Temple is a symbol of **equality and humility**, welcoming visitors of all religions and backgrounds without discrimination. It promotes the Sikh principle of treating all humanity as one.
 
• The temple's construction was initiated by the **fourth Sikh Guru, Guru Ram Das**, in the year **1581**. It was later completed under the supervision of **Guru Arjan Dev**, the fifth Sikh Guru.
